safe_fixes: [Replication Lag Issues] Check network latency between nodes. Consider upgrading secondary hardware. Review oplog size. For Atlas, consider scaling up the cluster.
[Missing Indexes] Run explain() on slow queries. Create compound indexes matching query patterns. Use covered queries where possible. Consider using $hint for query plan control.
[CPU Saturation] Profile slow queries. Add appropriate indexes. Consider upgrading CPU or scaling horizontally. Check for runaway operations with currentOp().
[Memory Fragmentation] Consider restarting mongod during maintenance window. This is often caused by varied allocation sizes. Monitor for memory growth over time.
